paths.name: react-native-webgpu
paths.message: The default entry must work without the optional react-native-webgpu peer. Only src/webgpu and src/gpu may import it; use `import type` for types.

paths.name: typegpu
paths.message: TypeGPU is build-time only: write shaders in shaders/ and run `bun run compile:shaders`; runtime code uses src/webgpu/compiledShaders.ts.
